verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents generating automations from a chat description ("Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you"), and its built-in MCP server lets AI assistants build flows through natural language. The editing half of the story is only evidenced for agents, where a described change rewrites the instructions and tools, not for flows. All support is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: documented natural-language editing of existing flows (not just agents), in-depth docs on the in-product prompt-to-flow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.
describe a change in the editor — "only reply to paying customers" — and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you
